comments.value:
Just a comment: We don't have RenderTexture, Texture, Texture2D, Texture2DArray, Texture3D, CustomRenderTexture, Cubemap or CubemapArray types exposed, so the way you would have to use it for now is by storing texture references in material properties and noodle it from a Material.GetTexture node.

Adding all Texture types should be left as its own canny: https://feedback.vrchat.com/vrchat-udon-closed-alpha-feedback/p/add-rendertexture-texture-sprite-texture2d-texture2darray-texture3d-customrender
FYI: another Graphics.Blit request from pre Udon era: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/graphicsblit-scripts

@{5a983204a1528d415c5ced46|full_name}: The canny post you linked is for avatars. This canny is for Udon (worlds).
Sorry for not making it clearer, but they are different features.
(probably not actually be in next update but in progress)
@{5a3c5fa04a8da67427803b3e|full_name}: hoping this could be available for avatars in the future as well
Probably should mark this as complete.
